tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Deep Cortex page ground (V3 `T.bg`). Never pure black. Midnight Bio and Bioluminescent come from the first DesignSystem mockup (`THEMES`); the V3 dropdown also names 'Neural Void', which was never defined.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Panels, inputs, tab bars, side nav, accordion rows (V3 `T.bg2`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised layers: dropdown menus, AI chat bubbles, chat composer (V3 `T.surface`).

tokens.name: section-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section band behind every second page section, edged top and bottom with `border`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline on panels, inputs, ghost buttons, list dividers, scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `bg`, `bg-2` and `surface` (≈17:1 on `bg`).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, inactive icons and tabs on `bg`/`bg-2`. Only ≈3.2:1 on `bg` — passes for 24px+ text and icons, FAILS 4.5:1 for small copy; kept exact from source. Midnight Bio (#7c88b0, ≈5.5:1) and Bioluminescent (#7cb092, ≈7.4:1) pass.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Synaptic Cyan, V3 value: primary actions, focus, active states, links, mono overlines. On dark it reads as text ≈14:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and spinner on a `primary` fill (the V3 primary button uses `bg` for its label). In Midnight Bio this puts `bg` on violet at ≈4.1:1 — just under 4.5:1 for 14px labels; flag.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Neural Amber: accents, warnings, 'collective learning'/human aspects, second slider and loader ring.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Violet: feature highlights, user avatar, security group, gradient end of the input focus line.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation, online dot, 'Strong' password, success buttons. White label on it fails contrast (≈1.3:1): use `bg` text on success fills.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons, field-error text and border. White label ≈3.4:1 — passes only at 18px+/bold; flag.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected fill: tab indicator, checked checkbox, active side-nav row (V3 `primary+'18'`/`'12'`).

tokens.name: primary-line
tokens.usage: Selected outline: tab indicator border, active side-nav border, section-label rule start.

tokens.name: primary-focus
tokens.usage: Focused input border (`1.5px`).

tokens.name: cortex
tokens.usage: Deep Cortex from the brand guide (Tailwind `cortex`); the original background before V3 deepened it to `bg`.

tokens.name: cyan-400
tokens.usage: Guide scale: lighter cyan for hover on dark.

tokens.name: cyan-500
tokens.usage: Guide scale: Synaptic Cyan as specified in the brand guide and the trailer (`--color-primary`).

tokens.name: cyan-600
tokens.usage: Guide scale: pressed cyan.

tokens.name: amber-400
tokens.usage: Guide scale: lighter amber.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Guide scale: Neural Amber (same value as `secondary`).

tokens.name: amber-600
tokens.usage: Guide scale: pressed amber.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Liquid Card fill, always with a 24px backdrop blur (`blur-glass`).

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Liquid Card hairline at rest; turns `rgba(0,240,255,0.3)` on hover.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Page hero only; fluid clamp(38px, 7vw, 78px). The key word may carry the cyan→amber text gradient.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: clamp(18px, 2.5vw, 26px). Stat numbers use the same size at 700 in `primary`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Accordion titles, dropdown values, nav labels (13px).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels at md; xs 11 · sm 12 · lg 16px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and panel captions (panel captions 600, 0.08em).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every interaction breathes. Every component flows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A design language built for intelligence that moves.
styles.usage: Running text; section subtitles in `muted`, max 520px.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: I've analyzed 847 active sessions across your cortex layer.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Checkbox and toggle labels, helper copy.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Numbered section overlines in `primary`; hero overline 0.2em in `muted`.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, telemetry, logs, slider values, metrics.
